added.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Platform
added.description:
This is a Fully Remote Job

About Our Client:

Panorama Education operates in the K-12 education technology sector, addressing the challenge of providing comprehensive student insights to modern school systems. By integrating academic, attendance, behavior, and engagement data with AI, the program enables educators to fully understand each student and make informed decisions. Supporting 15 million students across 2,000 districts nationwide, the organization has a significant impact on student outcomes.

About the Opportunity:

The SENIOR ENGINEERING MANAGER, PLATFORM leads the team responsible for the foundational capabilities that support the organization's products, including shared services, core infrastructure, developer tools, and operational standards. This role ensures the platform remains robust and scalable as the program grows, enabling rapid and secure product development. The manager collaborates with product leadership to align technical direction with strategic goals and supports the integration of AI workloads into the platform.

Responsibilities:

Lead and grow a team of senior and staff platform engineers, setting clear expectations and providing direct feedback.
Guide technical decisions on architecture, infrastructure, and system design, focusing on high-impact work.
Manage platform delivery from planning to production, defining and maintaining platform health metrics.
Develop strong operational practices including on-call and incident management with SRE.
Collaborate with AI platform and security teams to ensure infrastructure supports AI capabilities securely and efficiently.
Work with product management to shape and prioritize the platform roadmap.
Represent platform engineering in cross-team initiatives and provide leadership with transparent updates.
Ensure platform capabilities comply with security, privacy, and regulatory requirements, especially regarding student data.

Requirements:

Minimum 8 years software engineering experience, including 5 years managing engineers, preferably in platform-related teams.
Proven ability to manage senior and staff engineers with a leadership style based on clarity and trust.
Strong technical credibility with hands-on experience, especially with AWS; experience with Terraform and Kubernetes is a plus.
Experience partnering with product teams to deliver shared roadmaps and coordinating across engineering, security, and operations.
Disciplined in delivery, scope management, and defining completion criteria.
Focus on developer experience improvements such as CI/CD and internal tooling tied to productivity and retention.
Knowledge of security and compliance frameworks like SOC 2 and FERPA, with expertise in data protection.
Experience with scalable monitoring and observability.
Understanding of AI workload infrastructure demands and integration of AI-assisted tools and workflows.
Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field is preferred.

Pay Range and Compensation Package:

Base salary range: $194,051 - $285,369 USD annually.
Compensation includes annual bonuses or commissions, equity awards, and region-specific health and welfare benefits.

Benefits & Perks:

401(k) plan with employer match.
Health, dental, vision, life insurance, and short-term and long-term disability coverage.
Flexible spending accounts for health care and dependent care.
Wellness and work-from-home reimbursements.

Equal Opportunity Statement:
Our client is an equal opportunity employer. They celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or national origin.

Note:

TalentHop is not the Employer of Record (EOR) for this role. Our purpose in this opportunity is to connect exceptional candidates with leading employers. We help job seekers worldwide discover roles that match their goals and guide them to complete their full application directly through the hiring company's career page or ATS.

added.title: Sr. Manager, Analytics & BI Engineering
added.description:
This is a Fully Remote Job

About Our Client:

The organization operates within the analytics and business intelligence industry, addressing challenges related to consistent and reliable data reporting across multiple business functions and brands. It focuses on delivering governed metrics and reporting solutions that build trust in data and empower business decisions at scale.

About the Opportunity:

The SR. MANAGER, ANALYTICS & BI ENGINEERING leads the engineering function responsible for enterprise metric definitions and reporting delivery. This role is critical to establishing consistent, certified metrics and ensuring high-quality reporting assets that support data-driven decision-making. The position oversees both internal and external teams, implements engineering standards, and builds analytics capabilities across the organization.

Responsibilities:

Own the semantic layer as the source for enterprise metric definitions, ensuring design, certification, and enforcement.
Implement metric definitions in collaboration with data governance and product functions.
Manage quality, consistency, and certification of metrics and reports.
Ensure correctness, performance, and maintainability of reporting assets.
Define and enforce engineering standards for metrics and reporting.
Manage workspace structure, dataset certification, and access security.
Lead and mentor analytics engineers, BI developers, and analysts.
Establish metrics engineering as a formal discipline with standards and career paths.
Build delivery models and intake processes for metrics and reporting.
Lead analytics functions serving business areas with certified metrics-based reporting.
Develop analytics capabilities within business functions and transition ownership.
Direct external BI delivery resources, handling capacity and quality.
Provide metrics and reporting engineering support to cross-functional data teams.
Develop reusable semantic models and reporting patterns for consistency.

Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field; Master’s preferred.
8–12 years of experience in enterprise metrics, reporting, and BI solutions.
3–5+ years managing analytics or BI engineering teams.
Hands-on experience with enterprise reporting platforms (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Qlik).
Proficiency with semantic layer or OLAP modeling technologies.
Experience managing external delivery partners and contractor benches.
Proven ability to lead analytics teams serving business functions.
Experience building analytics capabilities within business units preferred.
Familiarity with cloud data platforms, preferably AWS, and dbt-modeled data.
Expertise in dimensional and semantic modeling, metric definition, SQL, and BI calculation languages.
Strong understanding of BI platform architecture and governance.
Ability to create scalable delivery standards and patterns.
Effective leadership, coaching, and talent development skills.
Skilled at balancing technical excellence with operational stability.
Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication abilities.

Pay Range and Compensation Package:

The pay range and compensation package for this role will be determined based on the candidate's experience, skills, and other relevant factors.

Equal Opportunity Statement:
Our client is an equal opportunity employer. They celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or national origin.

Note:

TalentHop is a recruitment partner of this role. Please note that all employment decisions, including candidate assessment, interviews, hiring, compensation, and employment terms, are made exclusively by the hiring employer.

added.title: Director, Technology Solution Marketing
added.description:
Bentley Systems

Location:
Philadelphia or Denver, US (Hybrid)

Position Summary

Bentley is seeking a marketing leader to define and drive the market narrative for our core technology platforms, including digital twins, AI, connected data, and platform capabilities.

Reporting to the VP of Product & Industry Marketing, this role shapes how Bentley's technology strategy is understood internally and differentiated externally. You will partner with executive leadership to develop long-term technology narratives, guide thought leadership, and ensure consistent positioning across products, industries, and go-to-market programs.

As a player-coach, you will lead, coach, and develop a team of solution marketers while remaining accountable for one or more strategic technology solution areas. Success in this role requires executive presence, exceptional storytelling, technical curiosity, and the ability to influence across a global, matrixed organization.

Responsibilities

Narrative & Executive Partnership

Act as a trusted thought partner with executive leadership to shape Bentley's long-term technology positioning and strategic direction.
Serve as the primary marketing advisor for Bentley's horizontal technology portfolio.
Translate technology strategy into differentiated market positioning and strategic messaging.

Messaging, Positioning & Thought Leadership

Define messaging frameworks for Bentley's core technology platforms.
Ensure consistent positioning across industries, products, and go-to-market initiatives.
Develop differentiated value propositions grounded in customer outcomes.
Drive Bentley's technology thought leadership by identifying emerging trends and partnering with executives on key industry narratives.
Engage analysts, customers, and industry influencers to validate and strengthen Bentley's market positioning.

Team Leadership

Lead, coach, and develop a team of solution marketers.
Personally lead strategic technology solution initiatives while remaining hands-on in messaging and positioning.
Align team priorities with business objectives and evolving market opportunities.

Go-to-Market Alignment

Partner with Product Marketing, Industry Marketing, Campaigns, Sales, and Corporate Marketing to activate technology messaging globally.
Establish scalable frameworks, standards, and processes for consistent execution across the organization.

Market Insight & Technology Fluency

Maintain deep expertise in AI, digital twins, connected data, cloud platforms, and emerging enterprise technology trends.
Synthesize analyst, customer, competitive, and market insights into forward-looking positioning and strategic recommendations.

Qualifications

15+ years of experience in B2B enterprise technology marketing, including leadership in platform, AI, cloud, data, or digital transformation solutions.
Demonstrated success influencing executive leaders and shaping company-wide technology strategy and messaging.
Proven ability to lead through influence across a complex global matrix organization.
Exceptional messaging and positioning capabilities, with evidence of simplifying complex technologies.
Experience building and leading high-performing marketing teams.
Strong cross-functional leadership across product, sales, and go-to-market teams.
Technical fluency and intellectual curiosity in relevant technology domains.
Bachelor's degree required or equivalent training or experience.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in infrastructure, AEC, or engineering software markets.
Experience marketing horizontal technologies across multiple industries.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without current or future employer sponsorship.

What We Offer

A great Team and culture – please see our colleague video. 
An exciting career as an integral part of a world-leading software company providing solutions for architecture, engineering, and construction - watch this short documentary about how we got our start. 
An attractive salary and benefits package. 
A commitment to inclusion, belonging and colleague wellbeing through global initiatives and resource groups. 
A company committed to making a real difference by advancing the world’s infrastructure for better quality of life, where your contributions help build a more sustainable, connected, and resilient world. Discover our latest user success stories for an insight into our global impact.

 About Bentley Systems

Around the world, infrastructure professionals rely on software from Bentley Systems to help them design, build, and operate better and more resilient infrastructure for transportation, water, energy, cities, and more. Founded in 1984 by engineers for engineers, Bentley is the partner of choice for engineering firms and owner-operators worldwide, with software that spans engineering disciplines, industry sectors, and all phases of the infrastructure lifecycle. Through our digital twin solutions, we help infrastructure professionals unlock the value of their data to transform project delivery and asset performance. www.bentley.com

Equal Opportunity Employer

Bentley is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, pregnancy, protected veteran status, religion, national origin, age, genetic information or any other protected characteristic. This commitment extends to all aspects of employment, including, but not limited to, hiring, placement, promotion, compensation, and training. Know Your Rights as an applicant under the law.
